justification: Inspected `byte-buddy-dep/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/utility/dispatcher/JavaDispatcher.java` at lines 262-269 and 527-561. `ForInstanceCheck` is a tiny nested `Dispatcher` implementation with one field (`target`) and only two behavior methods: `invoke` performs `target.isInstance(argument[0])`, and `apply` emits a single `INSTANCEOF`/`IRETURN` bytecode sequence. It is used only for `@Instance`-annotated methods, so it has a single cohesive responsibility and does not show insufficient modularization.
